title: hack/ci: rename STORAGE_FS to CI_DESIRED_STORAGE and add PODMAN_CI
body:
Renamed the variable the way you suggested rather than adding an alias, so `STORAGE_FS` is now `CI_DESIRED_STORAGE` in `runner.sh` and in the one place `test/e2e/common_test.go` reads it.

Dropped the runtime side completely, including the checks in `005-info.bats` and `info_test.go`, since crun is the only thing we test. `podman_runtime()` stays, it is used in eight other files.

The cirrus guards now key on `PODMAN_CI`, exported from `runner.sh`. `GITHUB_ACTIONS` was no good, `limactl shell` does not carry the host env into the VM.

Also only exporting `CI_DESIRED_COMPOSEFS` when we run rootful. That was danishprakash's point, un-skipping the storage test switches on the composefs assert below it and the config is only written into `storage.rootful.conf.d`, so rootless rawhide would have expected true and got `<no value>`.

#### Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?

```
None
```

comments.body:
nice work @vtushar06. I was looking at how this integrates with the rest of the CI scripts, and I have a couple of suggestions that might make this a bit more robust:

right now, the PR hardcodes `CI_DESIRED_RUNTIME=crun`, while `crun` is the default, if we ever run matrix jobs that test `runc` in the future (by setting `OCI_RUNTIME=runc`), the test will incorrectly fail. IMO since `OCI_RUNTIME` is already in the `PRESERVE_ENVS` list at the top of `hack/ci/runner.sh`, it might be safer to fallback to it like this:
   ```bash
   CI_DESIRED_RUNTIME="${OCI_RUNTIME:-crun}"
   ```

as you said the tests skip silently because they check for `CIRRUS_CI`. If we're fixing this for GitHub Actions, we should probably update the assertions in `test/system/005-info.bats` and `test/e2e/info_test.go` to check `if [[ -n "$GITHUB_ACTIONS" ]]` instead of `$CIRRUS_CI`. else if `CI_DESIRED_RUNTIME` ever accidentally gets dropped again in the future the test will just go right back to skipping silently instead of failing as intended, no?

what do you think ?

yeah I'll take the `${OCI_RUNTIME:-crun}` fallback as I checked and` test/e2e/common_test.go` already does exactly that, so it keeps things consistent.

On the CIRRUS_CI guards, I agree. I left them out to keep the diff small, but that drift protection is the whole reason those checks exist, so I'll switch them to GITHUB_ACTIONS in the same PR. Thanks :)
hi @mheon @timcoding1988 , can you have a look at this, all improvements are pushed only need your final check up.

Also note the GITHUB_ACTIONS env is not even set since that is so far not propagated into the tests. And in general I would think that is a poor marker, anyone could try to run our tests suites under github actions and thus not have to set our custom envs.

I guess some higher level marker env set as part of runner.sh might be better, i.e. PODMAN_CI

> With the CIRRUS_CI guard in the tests this does nothing.

Right. I set the variables and left the guard alone, so the drift protection I quoted as my whole reason for doing this is still dead. I'll do both together this time.

> for the runtime since we only test crun that seems pointless now

Fair, I'll drop the runtime side completely and take the check out rather than leave a test that can never fail.

> the GITHUB_ACTIONS env is not even set since that is so far not propagated into the tests

i checked this, and you're right. `limactl` shell doesn't carry the host env into the VM, and the only GITHUB_ACTIONS left in the tree is a commented out line in ci.sh. So PODMAN_CI in `runner.sh `it is.

> we can just reuse STORAGE_FS or well just rename that variable

@Luap99 this is the one I want to get right before I redo it, would you rather `STORAGE_FS` gets renamed to `CI_DESIRED_STORAGE` everywhere, or left alone with the test reading `STORAGE_FS` instead?

> @Luap99 this is the one I want to get right before I redo it, would you rather STORAGE_FS gets renamed to CI_DESIRED_STORAGE everywhere, or left alone with the test reading STORAGE_FS instead?

We can rename it to CI_DESIRED_STORAGE IMO
hey @Luap99 sorry, I pushed the redo and never said so here. STORAGE_FS is CI_DESIRED_STORAGE now and the CIRRUS_CI guard is PODMAN_CI, exported from runner.sh.
